# Kevin Joseph — Frontend Engineer

## Skills
- Angular: 8 years
- TypeScript: 8 years
- JavaScript: 8 years
- RxJS: 8 years
- HTML / SCSS: 8 years
- Nx: 4 years

## Tools
NgRx, Jest / Jasmine, Storybook, Nx Monorepo, SonarQube, GitHub Actions, Docker, PostgreSQL, SignalR, Datadog, Claude Code, Azure AI

## Experience
2020 — Present: Application Engineer at Banner Life Insurance
  Co-founded a 50+ component Angular library used by 6 applications, and built micro-libraries for auth, error handling, metrics and SignalR messaging. Co-led the move to an Nx monorepo with automated GitHub Actions releases, and led the test migration to Jest. Built the frontends for two internal AI assistants, launched a company-wide Claude Code plugin marketplace, and mentor junior engineers on design systems.

2018 — 2020: Associate Application Engineer at Banner Life Insurance
  Led frontend development of a rules-driven Angular app replacing a paper-based insurance process: instant decision rates from under 4% to 46%, exam-free applications from 0% to 80%. Built the Application Manager dashboard, cutting underwriting cycle time from 50+ days to about 11, and established the team's unit testing practices.

2017 — 2018: Member Technical Staff at Zoho Corp.
  Spearheaded early data modeling for Zoho Contract Management using PostgreSQL, reducing data redundancy by 20%. Collaborated in a 13-member team implementing backend APIs using PostgreSQL, Java, and an internal Zoho framework.

## Education & Certifications

- B.Tech. Computer Science and Engineering, College of Engineering Trivandrum (2013 — 2017)
- Azure AI Cloud Developer Associate, Microsoft Certified (2026)

## Projects
### Shared Component Library (Angular / Storybook)
Co-founded and grew an Angular component library to 50+ reusable components, documented in Storybook and shared across 6 applications in three product lines.
Tags: Angular, TypeScript, Storybook, SCSS

### Claude Code Plugin Marketplace (AI-Assisted Development)
Set up a company-wide Claude Code plugin marketplace and built its frontend plugin: hooks, agents and workflows that cut typical feature delivery from 1–2 days to 1–2 hours for 10 developers while keeping new code above 80% test coverage.
Tags: Claude Code, Agents, Hooks, Workflows

### Internal AI Assistants (Angular / RAG)
Built the Angular frontends for two internal AI assistants: a multi-model chat with model switching, and a RAG assistant with per-department document management that grew from a Licensing proof of concept to Underwriting and Audit.
Tags: Angular, TypeScript, RAG, Azure AI

### Frontend Platform & Monorepo (Nx / GitHub Actions)
Architected micro-libraries for auth, error handling, metrics and real-time messaging, co-led their move into an Nx monorepo, and replaced manual npm releases with automated CI/CD gated by SonarQube, Xray and unit tests.
Tags: Nx, GitHub Actions, SignalR, Datadog

### Online Application System (Angular / TypeScript)
Led frontend development replacing a paper-based life insurance process. Instant decision rates rose from under 4% to 46%, and exam-free applications from 0% to 80%.
Tags: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, SCSS

### Application Manager (Angular / TypeScript)
Built an internal dashboard for underwriters to manage assigned cases and auto-generated tasks, cutting the average underwriting cycle from 50+ days to about 11. Later extended it to give external agents real-time application status.
Tags: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, REST API
